\ednentry{
  id = {EDN-54},
  title = {A pipeline stage runs without MLflow unless tracking is required},
  date = {2026-09-30},
  milestone = {M3: Quality Assurance},
  topic = {CI/CD, Experiment Tracking},
  participants = {@lukas2510},
  decision = {A stage opens its MLflow run through \texttt{optional\_\allowbreak{}run}.
When no server is configured or reachable, the stage logs nothing, runs to completion and records \texttt{tracking\_\allowbreak{}mode: \textquotedbl{}disabled\textquotedbl{}} in \texttt{model.\allowbreak{}json}.
\texttt{RECOMMENDITOS\_\allowbreak{}REQUIRE\_\allowbreak{}TRACKING=\allowbreak{}1} turns a tracking failure into a failed stage.
There is no fallback to a local tracking store.},
  rationale = {\emph{Alternatives considered:}
\begin{itemize}[leftmargin=*, topsep=2pt]
\item Fail whenever tracking is unavailable: CI and a fresh clone have no DagsHub credentials, so \texttt{pytest} and \texttt{dvc repro} would fail for everyone.
\item Fall back to a local store: MLflow would write a database into the repository root on every run.
\item No switch that makes it fatal: nobody could show that the runs behind the reported numbers reached the server.
\end{itemize}
\par
\emph{Why:} Training without credentials is the normal mode for CI and for contributors.
The switch serves whoever produces the numbers for the report: with it, a misconfiguration cannot pass while logging nothing.
The artefact itself says whether a run was recorded.},
  ai = {Alternative generation, Alternative assessment, Recommendation, Solution generation},
  response = {Accepted},
  assessment = {AI saw that failing fast, which is right for a credential check, is wrong for a pipeline stage, and that a local fallback would leave a database in the repository.
It proposed the switch and used it in its own verification against the DagsHub server.},
  aievidence = {Claude Code session of 2026-09-30 on issue \#37.},
  evidence = {\texttt{optional\_\allowbreak{}run} in \href{https://github.com/mlops-2627q1-mds-upc/MLOPS_Recommenditos/blob/main/recommenditos/tracking.py}{\texttt{tracking.\allowbreak{}py}}, \texttt{tests/\allowbreak{}test\_\allowbreak{}model.\allowbreak{}py}, \href{https://github.com/mlops-2627q1-mds-upc/MLOPS_Recommenditos/issues/37}{issue \#37}.},
}
